title: MatchED: Crisp Edge Detection Using End-to-End, Matching-based Supervision
mechanism: A plug-in head of about 21K params. At each step it does one-to-one Hungarian matching, within distance tau_d, between confident predicted pixels and GT pixels. Matched GT moves to the matched prediction, unmatched GT is kept, and the crisp head is trained with BCE on this target.
adaptation: Crack and gridline only, tau_d = 2 px to match relF1@2. Candidate predictions are pixels with p > tau_c inside a 3 px dilation of GT, which keeps the cost matrix to a few thousand by a few hundred per cell, so scipy assignment on CPU is cheap. The head sits on top of the U-Net++ logits. Its 1 px output is dilated to the source's label width for strict IoU.
min_experiment: Arm: house + MatchED head (tau_d 2, tau_c 0.05), 5 seeds. Baseline: house at 100% labels. Metrics: relF1@2, relP@2/relR@2, recall of components >= 20 px, crack IoU, E1 relF1@2. Kill if relF1@2 and component recall are both within noise (< 0.01) or crack IoU drops by more than 0.012.
evidence: R: Average Crispness up 2 to 4x and ODS up 20 to 35% under crispness-emphasized evaluation on BSDS, NYUD, BIPED and Multi-cue, applied to PiDiNet, RankED, DiffusionEdge and SAUGE. Robust to tau_c (0.01 to 0.1) and tau_d (2 to 8). GPU memory reaches 28 GB at 320 px when tau_c = 0.01.
prior_overlap: Partly overlaps offset-tolerant CE (n.d.), which also tolerates shifts but allows many-to-one matches and so rewards thick output. One-to-one matching with a separate crisp head was not tested. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: tau_d = 2 px on the crack class only, on top of PF; one fixed jittered label per cell; tau_d = 0 control to separate the matching from the new sigmoid decision rule.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack and gridline only; tau_d = 2 px to equal relF1@2; restrict candidates to a 3 px dilation of GT plus confident pixels so per-cell scipy assignment is cheap (crack is 0.19% of pixels); re-dilate the crisp output to source width for strict IoU.
